register.title: Kevin Fang's direct certificates at 078789a, no issue
register.headline: Exact rational certificates at fourteen counts from 380 to 814, beyond the case corpus, from Kevin Fang's two-wedge search
register.source_checks: The source reports that three exact rational checkers accept all fourteen certificates: the author's verify.py --strict, his tools/rectcheck.py and Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py, unchanged; that his research repository's squarepack.verify --strict accepts each, with least wall clearances of 2.7e-20 and least pair gaps of 7.1e-21 to 4.1e-20; and that David Ellsworth's check_packing.py on each 40-digit export prints Container OK and Overlaps NONE. The source says the three checkers share the rational half-angle representation and the separating-axis method but no code. Their outputs are retained; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit the packings to Kevin Fang (https://github.com/TheSnakeFang/squarepack-certs), from his time-budgeted penalty search in the k^2 - k + 1 two-wedge family of Arslanov, Mustafin and Shangitbayev (Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 28(4), P4.22, 2021): 380 and 381 grown from Francisco Couzo's packing of 342 squares, and 421 through 381; 382 from Evan Daniel's improved packing of 343 of issue 489; the other ten from parametric two-wedge seeds. The certificate format is Evan Daniel's and the JSON layout SQUISH's (Nate Chaoweeraprasit). The search, the verifier and the bundle were written and run with Claude (Anthropic), directed and reviewed by the author.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay of all fourteen counts, then record each as a beyond-horizon row in report order. These certificates were first at 380 and 381 (e646c47, 2026-10-12T19:06Z), below the couzo-certificates-2026-10-11 rows, and first at 382 (c284cd0, 2026-10-13T00:05Z); Couzo's later #583 and #586 are smaller at all three. No other row or report names the other eleven counts. The n0508 side also bounds s(507), below the n0507 certificate's side, as a consequence with no entry of its own. Final exact-head CI remains required.
